version_rules.title: Outdated OpenSSH (username enumeration class)
version_rules.recommendation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 8.x+ and disable password auth in favour of keys.

version_rules.title: Outdated nginx
version_rules.recommendation: Update nginx to a current stable release and review CVEs for the running version.

version_rules.title: Apache httpd vulnerable to path traversal / RCE (2.4.49)
version_rules.recommendation: Upgrade Apache httpd to 2.4.51 or later immediately.

service_rules.title: Redis exposed without authentication
service_rules.recommendation: Bind Redis to localhost, require a password, and enable protected-mode.

service_rules.title: Elasticsearch exposed on the network
service_rules.recommendation: Restrict access to Elasticsearch and enable authentication (X-Pack/security).

service_rules.title: Cleartext Telnet service exposed
service_rules.recommendation: Disable Telnet and use SSH instead. Telnet transmits credentials in cleartext.

service_rules.title: FTP service exposed (cleartext credentials)
service_rules.recommendation: Prefer SFTP/FTPS. If FTP is required, disable anonymous access.

service_rules.title: MongoDB exposed on the network
service_rules.recommendation: Enable authorization and bind to trusted interfaces only.
